poses.name: speaking
poses.prompt: Pose her calmly explaining something, with both feet planted and her torso in a shallow three-quarter turn. Raise one bent forearm beside her torso, palm facing upward with fingers loosely together. Rest the other hand against her hip. Keep her head facing the viewer, with a friendly expression and mouth slightly open.

negative_prompt: artifacts, washed-out colors, low quality, low resolution, blurry, extra fingers, missing fingers, deformed hands, bad anatomy, extra limbs, text, watermark, signature
